title: Friends who fought the CIA and DNI internally

tellings.quote: Like I have friends who went to war with me against the CIA and DNI internally like went to war and said I can prove you're lying and did so.

plain: Some people inside the US intelligence world fought the CIA and the office of the Director of National Intelligence (the office that oversees all the US spy agencies) from within, telling them "I can prove you're lying" and then proving it. A guest named Dylan Borland tells Michels this as something he was part of: he says these friends "went to war with me" sometime in the 2020s. If true, it would mean insiders caught those agencies lying, though as he tells it, he does not say what the lies were about.
